name: Custom tube amps
summary: Bespoke amplifiers built around the sound you are chasing.
body: We work closely with you to design and build an amplifier that matches your style, your preferences, and your ear. Warm bluesy tones, searing rock overdrive, clean jazz clarity — each amp is tailored to the player it is built for.

name: Tube amp repairs
summary: Diagnosis and revival for gear that has seen better days.
body: Our technicians diagnose and repair tube amplifiers so they perform at their peak once more — everything from routine maintenance and re-tubing to complex faults in vintage circuits.

name: Residential
summary: Vintage warmth for your own listening room.
body: Amplifier repairs, maintenance, and custom modifications tailored to a personal audio space. If you have built a listening room, we will help it sound the way you imagined.

name: Commercial
body: We maintain and enhance amplification systems for venues, recording studios, and other commercial spaces, so what your audience hears is worth hearing.
